title: Orders, stock ledger và reservations
scope_items: Database Migration 00006: Added 7 PostgreSQL 17 tables (inventory_locations, orders, stock_movements, inventory_balances, stock_reservations, refunds, returns) with full Row Level Security (ENABLE/FORCE RLS), tenant isolation policies, strict foreign key references, and exact decimal money types (NUMERIC(18,6)).

Protobuf Contracts & Multi-Target Generation: Defined 3 canonical services (OrderService, InventoryService, RefundService) with 27 RPCs. Compiled and verified cleanly across all 4 targets (Go, Connect-Go, TypeScript, Dart) with zero codegen drift.
Acceptance Target 1: Inventory Fixtures I01-I10 implemented and passing under race conditions:
- I01: Simultaneous reservations for scarce stock fail closed on insufficient quantity.
- I02: Fulfill held order replay idempotency returns identical movement without double-deduction.
- I03: Bundle atomicity ensures all-or-nothing holds with zero orphaned lines.
- I04: Opening count baseline protects historical orders from re-deduction.
- I05: Physical return replay restocks goods while financial refund does not.
- I06: Reservation expiry races payment confirmation with deterministic atomic winner.
- I07: Cross-tenant isolation blocks cross-workspace operations fail-closed.
- I08: External count corrections reconcile balances safely even if available stock goes negative.
- I09: Immutable ledger reconciliation verifies sum(movements) matches balance projection.
- I10: Polled absolute platform count idempotency ignores identical re-observations.
Acceptance Target 2: Historical imports do not double-deduct stock. Orders with ordered_at <= opening_at boundary do not reserve or deduct inventory.

Acceptance Target 3: Partial refund followed by full refund works. Initial partial refund transitions order to partially_refunded, subsequent refund completing order total transitions to refunded, and over-refunding is strictly rejected.
Physical Returns vs Financial Refunds Separation: Return receipts trigger inventory restocking movements; refund approvals perform financial adjustments only without touching physical stock.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestI01 through TestI10 in apps/api/internal/inventory/fixtures_i01_i10_test.go pass with 100% clean race checks.
Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestHistoricalImportDoesNotDoubleDeductStock verifies opening baseline protection for imported orders.
Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestPartialRefundFollowedByFullRefund verifies partial refund followed by full settlement and rejection of over-refunds.
Order Ingestion Idempotency Verified: TestOrderIngestionIdempotency verifies duplicate prevention across import fingerprints and external IDs.
Order Lifecycle & Cancellation Verified: TestOrderLifecycleAndCancellation verifies state transitions and automatic release of stock reservations on cancellation.
Return Restock vs Refund Separation Verified: TestPhysicalReturnRestocksInventoryWhileRefundDoesNot confirms physical returns restock inventory while refunds do not.
ConnectRPC Handlers Verified: OrderServiceHandler, InventoryServiceHandler, and RefundServiceHandler compile and bind cleanly.
external_gates: External Commerce Connectors (Shopee, TikTok Shop, Lazada): Live OAuth and platform webhook credentials remain unconfigured in local test; hermetic ingest engine and idempotency guards are fully verified locally.

PostgreSQL 17 Database Service: Local PostgreSQL service container runs in GitHub CI; live integration test suites (TestPostgresLiveInventoryStore, TestPostgresLiveOrderStore) execute against the containerized PostgreSQL database.

P2-P8: Future modules (M04-M12, M14-M21) per IMPLEMENTATION_ORDER.md.
